name: Amaresh
reason: Correct amara+īśa; IAST and Devanagari agree.

name: Amiya
reason: Suitable Bengali name, but amiya is a vernacular/Prakrit form of amṛta, not classical Sanskrit; meaning note corrected.

name: Anukul
reason: anukūla; Bengali/Hindi final-a drop, Devanagari matches IAST.

name: Arkaprabha
reason: arka+prabhā; established Bengali boy's name, scripts agree (final a dropped in Devanagari).

name: Arunabh
reason: aruṇa+ābha, sandhi correct; final a dropped consistently.

name: Balmukund
reason: bāla+mukunda, Krishna name; Hindi spelling consistent with Devanagari.

name: Banamali
reason: Bengali form of vanamālī; Krishna name, scripts agree.

name: Bharatesh
reason: bharata+īśa sandhi correct; used in Karnataka (also Jain association, but valid given name); scripts agree.

name: Dattaram
reason: Devanagari had long ā (दत्ताराम = dattārāma) which contradicts IAST dattarāma; corrected to match.

name: Dwaipayan
reason: dvaipāyana, Vyasa epithet widely used as Bengali given name; scripts agree.
